name: nadiar-skills
description: Nadiar's personal Claude Code skills marketplace

plugins.name: superglue
plugins.description: Reference skill for Superglue 2.0 (thoughtbot's Rails+React+Redux framework, v2/beta) — navigation, Super Turbo Streams, forms, fragments/state, digging, deferments.

plugins.name: nano-banana
plugins.description: Generate, edit, and compose images with Google's Gemini image models (Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro) and write them straight into the workspace — writes the prompt for you, picks model and resolution, lands the file at the path you name.

plugins.name: qwen-image
plugins.description: Generate and edit images with Alibaba Cloud Model Studio's Qwen-Image models (qwen-image-3.0-pro, qwen-image-max, qwen-image-edit-max) and write them straight into the workspace — an alternative to nano-banana, and the better choice when the image needs legible text in it.

plugins.name: gtm
plugins.description: Read and write Google Tag Manager configuration — accounts, containers, workspaces, tags, triggers, variables — and publish container versions, via the Tag Manager API v2.

plugins.name: gsc
plugins.description: Read Google Search Console data — search performance, per-URL indexing status — and manage sitemaps, via the Search Console API v1.

plugins.name: ga4
plugins.description: Query Google Analytics 4 reporting data via the official analytics-mcp server, and manage property configuration (custom dimensions/metrics, key events, data streams) via the Admin API — against a service-account-scoped property.

plugins.name: meta-ads
plugins.description: Manage Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads — campaigns, ad sets, ads, creatives, insights, catalogs, datasets — via Meta's hosted ads MCP server at mcp.facebook.com/ads plus a guardrailed wrapper around the official ads-cli.
